g.text: Actual spectra and explicit model failures · None of these curves is a physical decomposition

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #556a79

g.text: All panels use archive-rescaled independent errors; smaller raw errors give worse residual scores (especially BLAGN-1).

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #556a79

g.text: Δχ² = 3.84 is a diagnostic, not calibrated confidence. Widths, continuum family and Gaussian resolution are assumptions.
